notes.scope: fixed ten-day indicative benchmark; current work and bounded recent service pressure
notes.raw_inventory: unbounded conserved physical ledger; not an accumulated willingness to pay
notes.bounds: anchored logistic price with baseline and derivative matched; no owner cost floor
notes.memory: bounded signed pressure halves after three turns without renewed slippage; raw barrels never decay
notes.calendar: daily seed rate applied to 3x10 operating days; source real-month volume is a diagnostic only
notes.calibration: design parameters, not empirical tanker-price calibration
